tokens.name: signal-red
tokens.usage: The brand red. Fills: buttons, the club stripe, the badge's inner ring, Car of the Week posts. As text only at 24px+ or bold 19px+ (3.8:1 on bone, 4.0:1 on black); smaller red text uses accent-text.

tokens.name: signal-red-pressed
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for signal-red buttons.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on signal-red fills (4.7:1).

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Raw palette. The warm paper ground of the club; Day surface and Night ink.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Day ink and Night surface; the second club stripe.

tokens.name: warm-gray
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Decorative rules and inactive marks only, never body text on bone (2.9:1).

tokens.name: dove
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Hairlines and sunken panels on bone.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and post background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels that sit on surface: event cards, the race plate.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, input fields, footer band.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (15:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, meta lines on surface and surface-raised (4.6:1 Day on bone, 6.2:1 Night on black).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Small red text: kickers, labels, inline links on surface and surface-raised (5.3:1 Day, 6.1:1 Night).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders that don't carry meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Plate borders, the badge outer ring outline, input borders (3:1+).

tokens.name: stripe-1
tokens.usage: Upper band of the club stripe.

tokens.name: stripe-2
tokens.usage: Lower band of the club stripe; flips to bone on dark grounds.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline at 2px offset on every interactive element (3.8:1 on bone, 4.0:1 on black, 4.7:1 on white).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero and post headlines. Always uppercase.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section headers, Instagram post titles. Uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Nav items, button labels, small headings. Uppercase.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Labels above titles. Uppercase, accent-text or ink-muted.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Coffee at seven, route brief at quarter past, wheels rolling by half.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Meet at the north lot. Full tank, clean glass, radio on channel 7.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Distances, times, counts. Uppercase with tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between the two stripe bands; icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: kicker to title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on mobile; default gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; post safe margin at 1x.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on the website.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding; Instagram safe margin (scaled to 1080).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Stripes, full-bleed bands, banners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, posts in a grid, race plates.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The badge, the mark and avatars only.

tokens.name: stripe-weight
tokens.usage: Height of each club-stripe band at web size; scale with the layout (14px on a 1080 post).

tokens.name: stripe-gap
tokens.usage: Space between the red and black bands; always half of stripe-weight.
